graph_props.Description: This PCG graph will create the lots and building footprints of the city. Ingesting the city shape and the road network footprint, it lets you adjust how many lots will be reserved for plaza or vegetation and the different building footprint sizes of the different district categories.

nodes.comment:
Sub-divides large district lots into a regular grid using road-width-scaled cells.
Produces inner block Areas and subdivision Splines for grammar assignment.
This creates the internal block structure within large city lots.
nodes.name: Subgraph_57
nodes.title: Subdivide Large Lots Into Grid

nodes.comment:
Assigns SGD_Road_City_HighRes_NoLines grammar to the grid subdivision splines.
The grammar drives which road mesh assets are spawned along the inner block edges.
spawnAssets=false here — actual spawning happens in Spawn Road Grammar Assets.
nodes.name: Subgraph_58
nodes.title: Assign Road Grammar To Grid Splines

nodes.comment:
Excludes the grammar road footprints from the large lot areas.
What remains are the inner building pads within each large block,
ready for per-footprint size filtering.
nodes.name: Subgraph_59
nodes.title: Carve Grammar Roads From Large Lots

nodes.comment:
Reads the Roads PCG actor output and selects only data tagged 'RoadFootprints'.
Used to cut road areas out of the city shape before lot generation.
nodes.name: Subgraph_60
nodes.title: Filter Road Footprints

nodes.comment:
Reads the Roads PCG actor output and selects data tagged 'ModifiedTerrain'.
This surface is used as the projection target when placing large lot road grammar assets.
nodes.name: Subgraph_61
nodes.title: Filter Modified Terrain

nodes.comment:
Spawns the actual road mesh assets along the grammar-assigned grid splines.
Projected onto the modified terrain surface so they sit flush on the ground.
nodes.name: Subgraph_63
nodes.title: Spawn Road Grammar Assets

nodes.comment:
Contracts the small lot polygon inward by 2000 units to define the inner courtyard boundary.
The ring between the original lot edge and this contracted polygon becomes the courtyard.
nodes.name: Subgraph_64
nodes.title: Contract Small Lots (Courtyard Inner Boundary)

nodes.comment:
Excludes the contracted inner boundary from the original small lot polygon.
The resulting ring-shaped area is the small courtyard footprint.
nodes.name: Subgraph_65
nodes.title: Carve Small Courtyard From Lot

nodes.comment:
Contracts the medium lot polygon inward by 3000 units.
Larger contraction than Small to reflect wider medium-district block proportions.
nodes.name: Subgraph_66
nodes.title: Contract Medium Lots (Courtyard Inner Boundary)

nodes.comment:
Excludes the contracted inner boundary from the original medium lot polygon.
The resulting ring is the medium courtyard footprint.
nodes.name: Subgraph_67
nodes.title: Carve Medium Courtyard From Lot

nodes.comment:
Removes large building footprints smaller than 2500 units.
Unselected (too-small) footprints are routed to Unbuildable Footprints.
Selected footprints are passed to the courtyard contraction step.
nodes.name: Subgraph_68
nodes.title: Filter Large Footprints By Min Size (2500)

nodes.comment:
Contracts large footprints inward by 900 units to produce the final
building pad area — the zone within which buildings can be placed.
nodes.name: Subgraph_70
nodes.title: Contract Large Footprints (Inner Building Pad)

nodes.comment:
Collects all six unbuildable lot streams (min/max size rejects for each
of Small, Medium, and Large districts) into a single data set.
Tagged 'unbuildableLots' and output for use by downstream graphs.
nodes.name: Gather_0
nodes.title: Gather All Unbuildable Lots

nodes.comment:
Collects unbuildable footprint streams from all three district sizes
(footprints that failed the minimum footprint size filter).
Tagged 'UnbuildableFootprints' and output for downstream use.
nodes.name: Gather_1
nodes.title: Gather All Unbuildable Footprints

nodes.comment:
Removes the highway footprint polygon from small district lot subdivisions.
Lots that intersect the highway are cut so buildings don't encroach on it.
nodes.name: Subgraph_72
nodes.title: Exclude Highway From Small Lot Subdivisions

nodes.name: Subgraph_73
nodes.title: Exclude Highway From Medium Lot Subdivisions

nodes.comment:
Randomly retains 90% of medium district building footprints.
Unselected (10%) are routed to Unbuildable Medium Building Footprint
to introduce variation and prevent every lot from being built on.
nodes.name: Subgraph_75
nodes.title: Random Cull Medium Building Footprints (90%)

nodes.comment: Move slightly above the ground tiles
nodes.name: Subgraph_76
nodes.title: Lift Grammar Points For Projection

nodes.comment:
Intersects large district lots with the highway footprint polygon.
The overlap area represents lots that sit beneath the highway structure.
Tagged 'UnderHighway' and output separately for special treatment downstream.
nodes.name: Subgraph_2
nodes.title: Large Lots Under Highway
